value_statement: Priority lists and timetable: Commission (after consulting the Committee); supplementing the essential-requirements list: Council on a Commission proposal; request for specifications: Commission to CEPT; drafting and consultation of other standardization bodies: CEPT. Qualitative per function and position; no aggregate.
inference_rule: Read from the NA and QR members of SC-01 by function slot and origin position.
aggregation_rule: None: stated at SC-01 scale; no summary across S.
rival_partition: Allocation by Council/Commission only, treating the CEPT as an external drafting contractor.

value_statement: Issuance of the certificate with accompanying data: approved laboratory (A7.P3; the issuer class of A2.P0.pt16 also lists the competent authority, not coded); recognition, no re-testing and mandatory use of specifications: competent authorities of the Member States; implementation: Member States. Qualitative.
inference_rule: Read from NA/QR members of SC-02 by function slot and origin position.
rival_partition: Issuer and recognizer merged as one national authority function (issuer class of A2.P0.pt16).

value_statement: Suspension and revocation: Member State; consultation, opinion-seeking, communication, recommendations or opinions and withdrawal decision: Commission; opinion: approved laboratory (ground (a)) or Committee (ground (b)); reimbursement: Member State toward the Commission; funding of the laboratory: Commission. The procedure for electrical-safety decisions is external (not in W).
inference_rule: Read from NA/QR members of SC-05 by function slot and origin position.
rival_partition: Allocation by ground: (a) and (b) as two separate procedures.

scale: SC-04 (waiver procedure), by function x position x relation
value_statement: Waiver: Member State discretion (permission) conditional on market consultation, unavoidable need and a limited period, with notification; Commission discretion to consult the Committee and "may request" CEPT revision; extension: Member State "may" with Commission agreement on Committee advice; Committee review obligation without stated consequence. Qualitative; not a score.
inference_rule: Read from the modality, conditions and discretion attributes of NA/QR members of SC-04.
rival_partition: Discretion allocated by case (a) and (b) separately.

scale: SC-05 (suspension and safeguard procedure), by function x position x relation
value_statement: Suspension, revocation: Member State permission on stated grounds; Commission: obligation to consult and to seek an opinion, recommendations "if necessary", obligation to decide on withdrawal after the Committee opinion; effect of recommendations not stated. Qualitative.
inference_rule: Read from the modality, conditions and discretion attributes of NA/QR members of SC-05.
rival_partition: Discretion allocated by ground (a) and (b) separately.

value_statement: Member State level: ensure duty and waiver permission; Community level: receipt of notification, consultation of the Committee, agreement to extension, CEPT revision request; Committee review. Qualitative description of two levels as stated.
inference_rule: Read from origin positions (Member State; Commission, Committee) in SC-04 members.
rival_partition: A one-level reading in which the Commission only receives information.

value_statement: Member State level: suspension and revocation; Community level: consultation, laboratory opinion, Committee opinion, recommendations, withdrawal decision, CEPT information/brief. Qualitative description of two levels as stated.
inference_rule: Read from origin positions in SC-05 members.
rival_partition: A one-level reading in which only the Member State acts.

value_statement: Two distinct decision competences by role are stated: Member State (suspend, revoke) and Commission (withdrawal decision; recommendations). The number of Member State decision centres is not stated.
inference_rule: Count of roles read from NA members that state a decision; instance counts only from stated multiplicity (PT-7).
count_basis: undetermined for Member States: W states only "Member States" (plural), number not stated
rival_partition: Counting the Committee as a decision centre (its opinion is advisory as stated).

value_statement: Drafting of specifications is allocated to the CEPT; the public or private character of the CEPT is not stated in W (A2.P0.pt1 distinguishes administrations from private operating agencies only for telecommunications administrations).
inference_rule: Read from QR a4_cept; no outside knowledge used.
rival_partition: Treating the CEPT as a public-body function.

value_statement: An accountability relation is coded with sufficiency indeterminate; missing elements: agent and standard of "not maintained", effect of recommendations or opinions, consequence of ground (b) assessment for the Member State.
Only INFO relations (notification, presentation of evidence) are coded; no ANSWERABILITY or ACCOUNTABILITY relation is coded in SC-04, within the declared corpus.
inference_rule: Per RGAM-DR-17 from the accountability attributes of SC-04 members; absence statement is about the search (CL-05).
rival_partition: Reading the Committee review and Commission agreement as accountability.

value_statement: The Committee opinion precedes the Commission decision on withdrawal ("On the basis of that opinion"); necessity of the stage cannot be asserted: the electrical-safety branch and the non-prejudice clause rest on external provisions.
inference_rule: Necessity is an absence-dependent claim: requires closure over provisions that could substitute the stage.

scale: SC-01 route for producing common conformity specifications
value_statement: Whether the Commission request to the CEPT is the only route for common conformity specifications cannot be asserted: A6.P1 regards NETs as equivalent without excluding other forms; NET adoption is external.
inference_rule: Substitutability is an absence-dependent claim: requires closure.

value_statement: Not attributable: no legal rule links successive relations (Council -> Commission -> CEPT -> recognition) as steps of a path; reachability is only a candidate positional property (RGAM-DR-21).
inference_rule: Path semantics would require a stated legal rule linking successive relations.
path_semantics: No path step semantics stated: no rule in W links the relations as transmission; graph reachability is not legal transmission.
rival_partition: Depth by function rather than by path.

value_statement: Undetermined at the architecture scale: values per S are reported (PROP functional allocation, discretion distribution); the Commission appears as a party in many relations, but connectivity is not legal status and no aggregation rule or index is defined.
inference_rule: No scalar or composite is defined; premature aggregation avoided.
aggregation_rule: No aggregation from S to ARCH-01 is made (ecological and atomistic fallacies avoided).
rival_partition: Centralization stated per function (as in PROP functional allocation).
